top_signals.title: $4,000 Gold Could Be Wall Street's Next Big Buying Opportunity
top_signals.summary: Gold is struggling to regain its footing after retreating from September highs above $4,400 an ounce, as a stronger U.S. dollar, surging Treasury yields and expectations of further Federal Reserve tightening weigh on the precious metal. But while speculative investors have been reducing their exposure, central banks and gold-backed exchange-traded funds continue accumulating bullion, raising an increasingly important question: Is gold entering a prolonged correction, or is the recent selloff creating another buying opportunity? Gold traded around…
top_signals.why_it_matters: Central-bank repricing affecting yields, FX, liquidity and equities.

top_signals.title: UK Grid Seeks Emergency French Power to Secure Supplies
top_signals.summary: Britain’s grid operator sought emergency assistance from France on Monday evening, requesting as much as 1,200 megawatts of additional electricity through an undersea interconnector to help maintain the security of the power system.
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.

top_signals.title: Crypto PACs report $2.7M spending blitz on House races as midterms loom
top_signals.summary: With just 22 days until the US midterm elections, a crypto-aligned committee has announced another major ad expenditure to support “pro-crypto” candidates in 2026.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Digital asset volatility and institutional crypto positioning changes.
